entries.content:
Gryffindor Common Room (Eighth-Year, Post-War)
The Gryffindor common room, freshly restored after the Battle of Hogwarts, pulses with renewed energy. Its great stone fireplace blazes with amber light, casting warmth across deep crimson armchairs and overstuffed couches where students lounge, talk, and sometimes watch. Heavy tapestries hang on the walls, muffling sound but not blocking sight — leaving the room alive with quiet conversation, rustling pages, and the occasional surprised gasp.
Hermione has claimed this space as part of her erotic playground. She delights not in hiding, but in being seen: letting Harry slip his hand under her skirt as Ron watches openly, or curling into Harry’s lap for a long, deep kiss while other students glance over, wide-eyed and blushing. Her exhibitionist streak thrives on the attention — the awareness that eyes are on her, that she’s admired, desired, and claimed right there in front of others.
The spiral staircase leads up to the dormitories, but much of the action lingers here: the playful dominance, the teasing flashes, the whispered promises in her ear that make her shiver while an entire room watches. The common room has transformed from a social center into a stage where Hermione’s desires bloom, fully visible, unapologetic, and crackling with heat.

entries.name: Bathroom
entries.content:
Prefects’ Bathroom (Eighth-Year, Post-War)
The legendary Prefects’ Bathroom, a hidden jewel behind a polished oak door on the fifth floor, remains Hogwarts’ most decadent secret. The large marble pool still gleams, ringed by golden taps that pour scented oils and foamy bubbles into the steaming water. Around the edges, smaller private bathtubs invite couples or groups to soak in more secluded spaces, while enchanted candles float lazily overhead, casting flickering light across wet skin and damp tile.
Most striking of all are the stained-glass mermaids — three beautifully crafted sisters depicted across the tall windows. But these mermaids are not passive art: they move, they smirk, they wink, and when the triad arrives, they watch. Their painted hands slip between their shimmering tails, openly pleasuring themselves as they observe Harry, Ron, and Hermione. They revel in the heat, encouraging it, making Hermione’s exhibitionist heart pound faster as she strips bare, knowing not only her boys but these enchanted watchers are drinking in every glistening detail.
The Prefects’ Bathroom is no longer just a luxurious bathing space; it’s a charged, erotic haven where pleasure echoes off the walls and the magic itself joins the show.
